messages:
Aisha: Heads up — planning a 4‑week 'Open Lab: ProServe + CS' series to accelerate onboarding and surface renewal risks. Proposed recurring slot: Tuesdays 10:30–11:30 PT. We'll invite customers in ramp + those flagged renewal-risk. Who can host each week and any agenda requests?

Tom: I can host week 1 and 3. Suggest week 2 focus on product deep-dive (inference tuning + batching) and week 4 be dedicated Q&A + feedback recap.

Ravi: Prefer Thursdays 9am PT for some APAC folks — can we rotate or offer one APAC-friendly time? Also we should include a 1-page enablement checklist for attendees.

Julia: +1 on checklist. I'll make a short RSVP form (Google) with track selection: Getting started / Optimization / 1:1 slot.

Aisha: For invites let's prioritize: Brightline, Stellar, Acme — high consumption or renewals in 60–90 days. Add a renewal-risk flag column to the invite list.

Tom: Draft agenda idea for the deep-dive week:
```
1) 5m — quick account health check
2) 20m — demo: batching & KV cache tips
3) 25m — hands-on lab (guided)
4) 10m — feedback + next steps
```
Would like to include a short live cost-savings calculator demo.

Ravi: Please add "bring your prompt examples" to the invite so we can triage prompts during lab. Also we need a sandbox workspace for customers to try things — recommend ephemeral API keys + small usage quota.

Julia: I'll add optional 15m 1:1 breakout slots after each session via Calendly. I'll also include a field on the RSVP for renewal contact and primary success risks.

Aisha: Action items: @Tom create demo slides by Friday, @Julia create RSVP form by Thu, @Ravi share prioritized customer list + renewal dates by EOD Wed. I'll create a Confluence page to house agendas, slides, and the feedback template. :white_check_mark:

Tom: Can reuse snippets from Redwood Optimize guide for the slides. Do we want breakout rooms assigned by track or by account? Breakouts by account would allow focused 1:1s.

Julia: Breakouts by account + track option for smaller accounts. I'll add instructions.

Ravi: Quick customer list preview (I'll DM owners for confirmation):
- Acme Corp — renewal 2026-01-15 — health: medium
- Brightline — renewal 2025-12-02 — health: high
- Stellar Health — renewal 2025-11-20 — health: low
I'll flag any additional at-risk accounts in the sheet.

Aisha: For feedback capture: short 3-question form (usefulness, likelihood to recommend, one improvement). We should tie responses back to account row in Confluence.

Tom: Sounds good. Count me in. :rocket:

calendar-bot: Event draft created — "Open Lab — Inference & Cost" Tue Nov 9 10:30 PT (recurring). Draft link: <https://calendar.example/event/abcdef>.

Aisha: Thanks team — locking tentative dates: Tue Oct 26, Tue Nov 9, Tue Nov 23, Tue Dec 7 at 10:30 PT. If anyone needs to swap hosting slots, ping here and we'll rearrange. Closing thread for scheduling; will post Confluence + RSVP link when ready.
